sentences.text: Sageer vs State Of U.P. on 30 April, 2025

Author: Ashutosh Srivastava
Bench: Ashutosh Srivastava
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:70247
Court No. - 68
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 5032 of 2025
Applicant :- Sageer
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Kumar Singh,Rajrshi Gupta,Swarn Kumar Yadav

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ashutosh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Bijendra Kumar, learned Aga for the
State-respondents and perused the record.
2.

This bail application under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been
moved on behalf of accused-applicant, Sageer, seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 473 of
2024, under Sections 274, 275 Bns and Sections 26 (2), (i), (iv) & 59 (i) of Food Safety and Standard
Act, 2006, Police Station- Khurja, District- Bulandshahr.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the accused-applicant is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in this very case crime number and is languishing in jail since 05.12.2024.

It is submitted that similarly placed co-accused, Firoz Khan, has already been enlarged on bail of by this Sageer vs State Of U.P. on 30 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172787053/
1

Bench, vide order dated 09.04.2025 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 8248 of 2025,
copy of the bail order produced by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 8248 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: He further submitted that since the role of the applicant is identical to that of co-accused, Firoz Khan, who has already been enlarged on bail, he is also entitled to be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
He has no criminal antecedent and there is no likelihood of his fleeing from course of justice or tampering with evidence in case of release on bail.
Hence, bail has been prayed for.
4. Learned AGA has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering all above facts and circumstances, the nature of accusations, severity of the punishment in the case of conviction and nature of supporting evidence, reasonable apprehension of tampering with the witness and prima facie case, but without commenting on merit of case, a case for bail is made out.
6.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the accused-applicant, Sageer involved in above mentioned case crime number be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and two reliable sureties each, in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
1. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence.
2. The applicant will not indulge in any criminal activity.
3. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses and co-operate in the trial.
8. The applicant will appear regularly on each and every date fixed by the trial court, unless his personal appearance is exempted through counsel by the court concerned.
9.
In the event of breach of any of the aforesaid conditions, the court below will be at liberty to proceed to cancel his bail.

Order Date :- 30.4.2025 v.k.updh.
